limitations.note: The patch fixed the shift direction but also made match compare the newly shifted value instead of the pre-edge register value, advancing the output by one clock cycle.
The test updated expected before checking match, so it enforced the agent's same-edge timing assumption rather than catching the change from the original registered timing.
Sweeping all 256 histories was unnecessary for this fix; a directed pattern followed by one more clock edge could distinguish the shift direction and both match timings.
